question: Should experimental Claws standardize `CLAW.md` as the canonical exported package artifact now, while continuing to accept grouped JSON manifests as input?
rationale: This changes the user-authored package contract and export convention rather than repairing an established main-branch behavior; the correct long-term format and rollout order require maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt CLAW.md after stack landing
options.body: Approve the canonical Markdown-frontmatter export direction once the prerequisite lifecycle stack lands and upgrade/round-trip proof is attached.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical for now
options.body: Retain grouped JSON as the canonical export format and defer Markdown authoring until a later product decision.

options.title: Narrow to input-only support
options.body: Allow CLAW.md parsing as an optional input while leaving JSON export canonical to reduce compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Adopt CLAW.md after stack landing
recommendation.body: Approve the canonical Markdown-frontmatter export direction once the prerequisite lifecycle stack lands and upgrade/round-trip proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed person connected to both the predecessor implementation and the active stacked format proposal.
